incident: lead ran `git stash` while 14 sub-agents were writing to the working tree
when: 2026-09-12, during a diagnostic comparison of the extensions/mod.rs fix
why_it_was_wrong: stash is a whole-tree operation; it reverted uncommitted work of every concurrently writing worker, not just the file under test. This violates the lead's own rule of never disturbing worker state.

also_reverted_then_restored.Cargo.toml: lost the `v7` uuid feature (needed by workers)

damage.git_stash_pop_conflict: Cargo.lock, core/agent_session.rs, core/sdk.rs - pop aborted, stash kept

recovery: extracted all 10 stashed files with `git show stash@{0}:<path>` into .port-env/stash-restore/ while workers kept writing, then copied back ONLY the files where the live copy had not already advanced past the stash; live-newer files were left alone. Cargo.toml uuid v7 feature restored. Stash dropped only after every file was verified on disk.
verification: mapped-file emptiness re-checked after recovery: 4 empty files (was 5 before the incident; sdk.rs got written by its worker during recovery). cargo check -p pi-coding-agent runs and reports type errors, so the crate parses.
secondary_error_i_made: I also ran os.environ['GIT_DIR']='' which broke the recovery redirects (produced 0-byte extracts) and made later git commands report 'not a git repository'; fixed by popping GIT_DIR and re-extracting.
rules_added: NEVER run git stash/reset/checkout while sub-agents are live.
To compare a proposed change against its base, copy the file to a temp path; never mutate the shared tree.
If the tree must be manipulated, first confirm zero live writers.
